title: From Language to Creative Writing : An Introduction
author: Seargeant, Philip
summary: This textbook offers an innovative introduction to the study of the English language and the practices, skills and strategies of creative writing. For anyone studying English Language or Creative Writing at tertiary level or in higher education, or for developing writers and those interested in the nature of linguistic creativity, it offers a uniquely integrated approach. Readers will better understand the structure and uses of language and be able to use a full range of strategies in crafting and developing their own writing.Offering a detailed investigation of language, the authors examine both everyday use and examples from literature and the media to illustrate the diverse ways in which language is used in a variety of social contexts. They consider accent and dialect, standard and non-standard English, how language use varies according to its purpose, and the relationship it has to identity. Interwoven with the study of language are creative writing chapters that introduce strategies for the reader to draw upon in their own writing. Practical writing exercises develop the ability to select and shape language for different effects, create voice in a story, and utilise patterns of sound in the composition of poetry. This unique textbook will develop a better appreciation of language in use, as well as the skills to craft writing in distinctive ways.

title: Tok Tam Malaysian's folk tales episode 16
summary:
“ Tok Tam” revolves around a group of animal who live in a small Malaysian Village. They lives in a barn led by an old wise Turkey, Tok Tam. Along with him there are the family of Jaguh the rooster, Bu the hen and their chicks, Chick and Chack. There are also Misai the cat, Mak Boo the cow, Pak Bekk the goat, Cik Lenggang the duck and Cik Siti the mouse. In the series, Tok Tam will tell moral stories fill with message and values for the viewers. Among the stories that will be told are.The Rabbit and The Tortoise, The Greedy Lion, The Wise Mousedeer and others.

In every episode, you will also be entertained with folk song from the region. The song will be presented with dances and sketches perform by the animation characters from the series. The series will also potray advice and guidance in a special segment with Tok Tam on safety measures such as how to cross the roads, handling electrical appliances and others. Meanwhile, Professor Jampuk the Owl and friends, will teach alphabets A to Z and introduce shapes and colors. Jaguh and Family will visit interesting holiday location in a special segment, which will blend the animation characters of Jaguh and family with actual visual from the places
